page.overview:
What is Misuse of Muggle Artefacts Office?

The Misuse of Muggle Artefacts Office was a division of the Department of Magical Law Enforcement at the British Ministry of Magic. Its head of office was Arthur Weasley until 1996, when he was promoted to head of the Office for the Detection and Confiscation of Counterfeit Defensive Spells and Protective Objects.

The Misuse of Muggle Artefacts Office was located on the second level of the Ministry of Magic. The office was tiny and drab, but filled with files and charmed objects such as 'an old toaster that was hiccoughing in a disconsolate way and a pair of empty leather gloves that were twiddling their thumbs'.

The Misuse of Muggle Artefacts Office regulated the use of magic on Muggle objects and tried to keep items that had been bewitched away from Muggles. To this end, members of the Office often participated in raids to keep Dark magic items out of circulation. There appeared to be a law prohibiting the enchantment of a Muggle item with the intent to use it for purposes other than for what it was designed; Arthur Weasley claimed he was able to bewitch a Ford Anglia to fly legally because he did not intend to fly the car.

After rescuing Harry from near-starvation by the Dursleys, Ron explained a scenario in which a deceased witch's bewitched tea-set ended up in the possession of a Muggle woman. When the woman served tea with her friends, the teapot and the sugar tongs attacked the Muggles, causing one man to end up in hospital with third-degree burns and possibly a broken nose.
